title: Soft backend: add CKM_RSA_PKCS_OAEP
description: wolfCrypt has wc_RsaPublicEncrypt_ex with WC_RSA_OAEP_PAD but wolfP11 does not expose CKM_RSA_PKCS_OAEP through C_Encrypt/C_Decrypt. Implement OAEP encrypt and decrypt in wp11_backend_soft.c, add CKM_RSA_PKCS_OAEP to g_mechs[], and add the mechanism info case to C_GetMechanismInfo.
